# dsh-plugin-zsxq
中文 | English
**Turn the Knowledge Planet (知识星球 / zsxq) planets you subscribe to into a searchable local Markdown
knowledge base — from inside DeepSeek Harness.**
Sync posts and attachments, extract `docx` / `PDF` text and images, rebuild an index, and search it
— all in pure JavaScript. No Python, no external services, no telemetry.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Why
Knowledge Planet content is awkward to keep: posts live behind an app, the substantial parts are att
achments (`docx`, `PDF`, audio), and there is no full-text search across your own history. If you re
ad on a computer — or want an agent to work with what you paid for — you end up exporting files by h
n a computer — or want an agent to work with what you paid for — you end up exporting files by hand.
This plugin makes your own subscription local and queryable:

- 📥 **One call to sync** — today, a date, a whole month, a count, or a hashtag
- 📄 **Attachments bec
ome text** — `docx` paragraphs and embedded images, `PDF` text and page images, all written into the

Markdown next to the post
- 🔎 **Search that respects your subscription** — keyword / tag / channel

/ category / date over a local index
- 🧠 **Agent-friendly** — seven typed tools; pair with the `dsh-

skill-zsxq` skill for the enrichment conventions (category, summary, quotes)
- 🔒 **Local first** — e

verything lives in a folder you choose; your Cookie never leaves `config.json`
- 🐍 **No Python** — t
his is a from-scratch JS port of the Python skill, validated byte-for-byte

2. **Add your Cookie**

1. Open <https://wx.zsxq.com>, log in, and confirm your planets render;
2. `F12` → **Network** → fil

ter `api.zsxq.com` → reload → click any request;

3. **Pick your planets**
Ask: *“check the zsxq setup”* → `zsxq_doctor` validates the Cookie against the live API and reports
which planets your account can reach. Add the ones you want to `config.json`:

4. **Sync**
*“sync today’s posts”* → `zsxq_sync` with `mode=today`.
5. **Enrich, index, search**

Let the agent fill `topic_category` / `keywords` / `summary` and create `.quotes.md` (the skill

ribes the rules), then *“rebuild the index”* → `zsxq_rebuild_index`, and search:

dge base for liquidity”* → `zsxq_search`.
## Tools
| Tool | What it does | Writes |

| `zsxq_init` | Create the data directory and a `config.json` template | yes (first run) |
| `zsxq_d

octor` | Validate Cookie against the API, report reachable planets, check index health | no |
| `zsx

q_list_channels` | List configured channels | no |
[该节后续省略]
## What gets extracted
| Attachment | Extracted |

| `.docx` | paragraphs (body-level, python-docx semantics) + `word/media/*` images |
| `.pdf` | page

text (CJK included, via bundled CMaps) + page images as PNG |
| `.mp3` / audio | downloaded only (t

ranscription is out of scope) |
| post images | remote signed URLs kept in Markdown |
| article post
s (`inline_article_url`) | HTML body → plain text |

Images extracted from attachments are written next to the Markdown as
`embedded-<attachment>-<index>
.<ext>` and referenced from a `## 🖼️ …` section.
## Privacy & security

- Everything is written locally under `dataDir`; the plugin never uploads content anywhere.
- The Co

okie is read from `config.json` on disk and sent only to `api.zsxq.com` / signed attachment URLs.
-

No analytics, no telemetry, no background network calls beyond the API requests you trigger.
- Destr
uctive operations require explicit confirmation; sync is idempotent.
## Limitations
- **No ASR** — audio is downloaded, not transcribed. (Voice placeholders are left in the Markdown.)

- **No image generation** for quote posters.
- **Scanned PDFs** have no text layer → text is empty (

OCR is out of scope).
- **docx tables / headers / footers** are not extracted (same as the Python or

iginal).
- Article-post HTML extraction is best-effort: paywalled or JS-rendered pages may yield les

s text.
- Requires a valid subscription Cookie; the plugin cannot access planets you are not a membe

t.
